templates.summary: Remove /var/run/docker.sock mount from container or Pod manifest.
templates.k8s_patch_hint: Remove hostPath volume path /var/run/docker.sock and its volumeMount.
templates.retest: Rescan mounts and confirm docker.sock evidence is absent.

templates.summary: Drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN and avoid privileged containers.
templates.docker_hint: Use --cap-drop=ALL and add only required capabilities.
templates.k8s_patch_hint: Set securityContext.privileged=false and drop ALL capabilities.

templates.summary: Upgrade affected container runtime to a fixed version.
templates.k8s_patch_hint: Upgrade node runtime packages and roll nodes safely.
templates.retest: Confirm runtime version no longer matches vulnerable range.

templates.summary: Avoid hostPath/subPath exposure or enforce admission restrictions.
templates.k8s_patch_hint: Deny hostPath with Pod Security Admission/Kyverno/Gatekeeper.
